incidents.source_text: On 30 December, in Kassala town, Kassala State, unidentified gunmen robbed an NGO guesthouse and assaulted a guard, who was injured.
incidents.title: Gunmen rob NGO guesthouse in Kassala town
incidents.description: On 30 December, unidentified gunmen robbed an NGO guesthouse in Kassala town, Kassala State, and assaulted a guard, who was injured.

incidents.source_text: On 1 January, near Wad Sharifey camp, Kassala locality, a local NGO staff member was briefly detained by armed men.
incidents.title: NGO staff member detained near Wad Sharifey camp
incidents.description: On 1 January, armed men briefly detained a local NGO staff member near Wad Sharifey camp, Kassala locality.
